title: The Future of California Ports: The First Hybrid Battery Electric Vessel
description:
A new era of sustainable maritime transportation has arrived at the Port of Los Angeles. ⚓🌊

Docked in Long Beach Harbor, the 108-foot passenger vessel El Escudo is redefining eco-friendly travel with its groundbreaking hybrid technology. Featuring the world's first parallel hybrid propulsion system, the vessel can operate on battery-electric power with zero emissions for hours at a time, helping reduce its environmental impact while delivering a smooth passenger experience.

Designed to accommodate up to 350 passengers, El Escudo is built for a wide range of activities, including harbor tours, whale-watching excursions, dining cruises, and ferry services. Combining innovation, sustainability, and comfort, this vessel represents the future of clean transportation on the water.
